generator.channel_provenance: Every channel panel was image-generated in its corresponding atlas. No procedural normal, roughness, metallic, AO or height derivation was performed.
generator.postprocessing: Original PNGs copied unchanged. Pillow crop at exact 512-pixel grid; lossless WebP encoding only. No retouching or resampling.

guide.procedure: Fresh guide separately downloaded with curl and read before each of the three generation calls; exact guide copies retained per asset.

visual_validation: All three atlases inspected at generation output. Six correctly ordered panels, no text or labels. Natural photographic materials; full rug with no repeating-fragment crop. Exact image dimensions and lossless export pixel identity mechanically checked. Seamlessness and perfect physical cross-channel registration are generative intents, not measured guarantees.

asset: six-channel physically based texture atlas for aged dark bottle-green / forest-green Chesterfield leather in a photographic PlayStation 2 era bathhouse reception environment.
subject: a flat seamless leather surface, fine natural leather grain, fine creasing, restrained oil-polished contact marks and subtle age variation. Geometry will supply all sofa shape and tufting; this image contains only the leather material surface.
style: natural photographic material texture with restrained low-resolution game realism, not pixel art. Neutral albedo without baked directional lighting, highlights, cast shadows or ambient illumination gradients.
layout: output exactly 1536 pixels wide by 1024 pixels high, aspect ratio 3:2. Exactly six contiguous square 512-by-512 pixel panels in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid. No gutters, no borders, no headings, no captions, no panel labels. The six panels show precisely the same material patch with identical grain and crease positions and scale.
panel positions: upper left (x 0–511, y 0–511) BaseColor; upper middle (x 512–1023, y 0–511) tangent-space Normal; upper right (x 1024–1535, y 0–511) Roughness. Lower left (x 0–511, y 512–1023) Metallic; lower middle (x 512–1023, y 512–1023) Ambient Occlusion; lower right (x 1024–1535, y 512–1023) Height.
channel appearance: BaseColor is deeply colored muted bottle/forest green leather with fine photographic pores and creases, never gray or black. Normal is an OpenGL tangent-space purple-blue normal map, flat value approximately RGB 128,128,255, with low-relief fine grain and shallow creases. Roughness is a grayscale map, medium-gray polished leather with locally darker smooth contact areas and slightly lighter fine creases. Metallic is solid black because leather is nonmetal. Ambient Occlusion is predominantly white with delicate darkening only in matching tiny crevices. Height is mid-gray with subtly brighter raised grain and darker fine creases. All six channel images must be generated directly and correspond spatially.
framing: orthographic flat texture scan, edge-to-edge material, no perspective, seamless wrap in both directions; one square patch represents approximately 0.6 by 0.6 meters.
Avoid: pictured sofa, tuft buttons, quilting diamonds, upholstery seams, pictured objects or furniture, deep folds, neon green, excessive yellow, pixel-art blocks, excessive sharpness, exaggerated cracks, glare, text, borders, labels, watermarks.

material_usage.notes: Dark bottle/forest green natural leather grain and shallow creases. Geometry must provide tufting, no tuft buttons baked into texture.

style: flat photographic textile scan, naturally worn woven fibers, intricate readable geometry, restrained photographic PS2 game texture quality, not pixel art. Base color contains neutral material color without baked lights, cast shadows, directional shading or glare.
layout: output exactly 1536 pixels wide by 1024 pixels high, aspect ratio 3:2. Exactly six contiguous square 512-by-512 pixel panels in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid. No gutters, no borders between panels, no headings, no captions, no panel labels. The six panels show precisely the same complete rug with identical pattern, fringe, edge, and wear positions.
panel positions: upper left (x 0–511, y 0–511) BaseColor; upper middle (x 512–1023, y 0–511) tangent-space Normal; upper right (x 1024–1535, y 0–511) Roughness. Lower left (x 0–511, y 512–1023) Metallic; lower middle (x 512–1023, y 512–1023) Ambient Occlusion; lower right (x 1024–1535, y 512–1023) Height.
channel appearance: BaseColor has a balanced detailed burgundy central field, muted ochre and cream geometric medallion motifs and complete richly patterned border. Normal is an OpenGL tangent-space purple-blue normal map, flat value approximately RGB 128,128,255, containing only tiny textile relief, worn pile and short fringe details, not deeply embossed color motifs. Roughness is a predominantly light-gray grayscale textile map with subtle wear variation. Metallic is solid black because wool textile is nonmetal. Ambient Occlusion is predominantly white with restrained crevice darkening among matching weave and fringe. Height is gray with subtle pile variation and matching fringe, slight brighter intact fibers, never bold relief of printed colors. All six channel images must be generated directly and correspond spatially.
framing: exact orthographic overhead scan, zero perspective, full rug visible, use once without repeating; material mapped to the full 2.7 by 1.8 meter rug.
Avoid: cropped border, missing corners, partial rug, infinite rug pattern, multiple rugs within one map, furniture, floor, room, large black exterior mask, text, labels, watermarks, oblique camera, cartoon or pixel-art blocks, excessive yellow, oversharpening, excessive highlights.

material_usage.notes: Complete rug encoded into square UV tile. Map once onto a 2.7 by 1.8 m rectangle to restore its 3:2 world aspect. All corners, borders and left/right short fringe are visible. Small dark gaps around fringe are opaque. Generated roughness/AO follow pattern more strongly than ideal textile microstructure; keep normal and AO contribution restrained, keep rug visually rough. Metallic panel has faint gray fringe; material metalness=0 preserves nonmetal behavior.
